crossRefs.note: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know…
Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which…
Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did…
Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!

translations.web: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.
translations.bsb: “I will make mere lads their leaders, and children will rule over them.”
translations.kjv: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule
